headline: Is there still a soulmate out there for me?
note: generated from REVIEW-new-voice.md — not a wired draft

a: You turned the Magician. Nothing marked them apart, and your hand went to the worker of the three.
Look at his hands. Both are busy, and neither one is idle.
You asked if there's still a soulmate out there for you. What catches me is that all four lie out in the open.
And yet nobody has come. And you're the one asking whether it's still real.
Something turns up at the point where it would start. I don't think any of it began with you.
Let me look closer at what's there…
b: You turned the Hanged Man. You couldn't see them, and yours was the only card still growing.
Look at the wood he hangs from. Green leaves are on it, and it's living wood.
You asked if there's still a soulmate out there for you. There's a rope on something still alive.
Still, nobody has come. And you've been asking whether there's anything left to wait for.
The hold on this is steady, and nothing in it moves. I don't think it began with you.
Let me look closer at what that is…
c: You turned the Fool. Face down, all three, and you took the one already stepping.
Look at his feet. One is lifted, and the other is following.
You asked if there's still a soulmate out there for you. This card brings me to a step in the middle of happening.
But nobody has come. And you're the one asking whether any of it is still real.
Something sits at the point where that step lands. I don't think this began with you.
Let me look closer at what's got hold of it…
